tools.description: List which cities this server knows about, optionally filtered by country, continent or a name fragment. Call this first when a city might not be covered — the other tools fail rather than guess.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "destination_costs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
